description: SYNTHETIC Microsoft 365 Message Center-style notices for demos and tests. Fictional content: these are NOT Microsoft announcements. Field names follow Microsoft Graph serviceUpdateMessage so a real, sanitized export can replace this file.

messages.title: [SAMPLE] Authentication methods: SMS sign-in will require a policy update
messages.body: Fictional sample. Tenants where SMS is enabled as a sign-in method must move users to another method before the action-required date. Tenants where SMS sign-in is disabled are not affected.

messages.title: [SAMPLE] Exchange Online: a legacy mailbox access protocol will be turned off
messages.body: Fictional sample. Mailboxes that still use the legacy protocol need a modern client. The tenant profile must show the protocol usage to evaluate impact.

messages.title: [SAMPLE] Microsoft Teams: updated layout for meeting recap
messages.body: Fictional sample. Informational update with no admin action.

messages.title: [SAMPLE] Microsoft Viva: new analytics dashboard
messages.body: Fictional sample for a service the sample tenant does not use.
